newsitem.title: UK: Euro fuel oil fades gently in thin business.
newsitem.headline: Euro fuel oil fades gently in thin business.

text.p: NWE fuel oil barge prices faded a little on Tuesday in thin business, traders said.
August high sulphur barges began the day offered at $91.50 a tonne but later traded at $90 in Antwerp.
There was an end-July physical trade at $89.50 and swaps for August and September flattened out, leaving nominal prices for the whole of the third quarter clustered around the $90 mark.
Talk persisted that Russian cracked cargoes would appear on the market in greater volumes since arbing out of the region has become unprofitable.
But traders anticipated the barrels would be absorbed and would have little depressive effect on prices.
